mechanics.title: Dark Gifts
mechanics.summary: From turn 3, spend 3 Gold to Discover a minion and Dark Gift bundle, at most once per turn and three times per game.

mechanics.title: Activate
mechanics.summary: Pay Gold during the Recruit phase to trigger an ability once per turn.

mechanics.title: Lockbox and Fishbait
mechanics.summary: Season 14 adds the Pirate Lockbox and Beast Fishbait mechanics.

mechanics.title: Trinkets
mechanics.summary: Trinkets remain active with an expanded pool in patch 36.2.
